fullText.simplified:
八、她希望我们过得好

    “多多，你还生气吗？”我问多多。
    “爸爸，我不生气了，我知道你是个好爸爸。我一直对我的同学和朋友说，我爸爸是最好的医生，他治好了很多人的病。”
    “谢谢你，多多，谢谢你这么好。”
    “我爱你，爸爸。”
    “我也爱你。你能告诉我你是从什么时候开始不喜欢香蕉牛奶和蛋包饭的吗？”
    “我不记得了。应该是懂事以后，因为你不喜欢，所以慢慢地我也不喜欢了。”
    “啊？是因为我吗？”
    “是啊，你没有发现吗？我上中学以后，妈妈都没有买过香蕉牛奶了。”
    “好像是这样，对不起，我现在才知道。”
    “爸爸，我们不要再说对不起了。妈妈在天上看着我们呢，她希望我们过得好。”
    “去世的人会在天上看着家人，这是很久以前的老人说过的话，你也相信吗？”
    “我相信，爸爸。”
    “好的，多多，那我也相信。”
    多多笑了，高兴地笑了。这是阿乐去世后，我第一次看到她高兴的样子。
    这天以后，多多和我的关系变好了。“适应阶段”过去了，她像以前一样和我说话，真正地说话。她的话变多了，她和我说工作的事，说学校的事。以前阿乐一定也和我说过这些话，但我没有好好听。现在我认真地听多多的话，她说的每件事我都不想错过。慢慢地，多多的笑多了起来。她变得越来越好，也越来越像阿乐。
    时间过得很快。四年后，多多三十一岁了，她成了音乐学院的学生们最喜欢的老师。她的工作变忙了，和我聊天的时间也变少了。这是好事，因为我知道她过得很好。而只有她过得好了，我才能离开。对，是离开，我最后还是要离开的。我不能真正地陪伴她，她需要一个真正的人来陪她过每一天。
fullText.traditional:
八、她希望我們過得好

    “多多，你還生氣嗎？”我問多多。
    “爸爸，我不生氣了，我知道你是個好爸爸。我一直對我的同學和朋友說，我爸爸是最好的醫生，他治好了很多人的病。”
    “謝謝你，多多，謝謝你這麼好。”
    “我愛你，爸爸。”
    “我也愛你。你能告訴我你是從什麼時候開始不喜歡香蕉牛奶和蛋包飯的嗎？”
    “我不記得了。應該是懂事以後，因為你不喜歡，所以慢慢地我也不喜歡了。”
    “啊？是因為我嗎？”
    “是啊，你沒有發現嗎？我上中學以後，媽媽都沒有買過香蕉牛奶了。”
    “好像是這樣，對不起，我現在才知道。”
    “爸爸，我們不要再說對不起了。媽媽在天上看著我們呢，她希望我們過得好。”
    “去世的人會在天上看著家人，這是很久以前的老人說過的話，你也相信嗎？”
    “我相信，爸爸。”
    “好的，多多，那我也相信。”
    多多笑了，高興地笑了。這是阿樂去世後，我第一次看到她高興的樣子。
    這天以後，多多和我的關係變好了。“適應階段”過去了，她像以前一樣和我說話，真正地說話。她的話變多了，她和我說工作的事，說學校的事。以前阿樂一定也和我說過這些話，但我沒有好好聽。現在我認真地聽多多的話，她說的每件事我都不想錯過。慢慢地，多多的笑多了起來。她變得越來越好，也越來越像阿樂。
    時間過得很快。四年後，多多三十一歲了，她成了音樂學院的學生們最喜歡的老師。她的工作變忙了，和我聊天的時間也變少了。這是好事，因為我知道她過得很好。而只有她過得好了，我才能離開。對，是離開，我最後還是要離開的。我不能真正地陪伴她，她需要一個真正的人來陪她過每一天。

sentences.pinyin: duō duō nǐ hái shēng qì ma wǒ wèn duō duō
sentences.english: “Duoduo, are you still angry?” I asked Duoduo.

sentences.simplified: “爸爸，我不生气了，我知道你是个好爸爸。
sentences.traditional: “爸爸，我不生氣了，我知道你是個好爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba wǒ bù shēng qì le wǒ zhī dào nǐ shì ge hǎo bà ba
sentences.english: “Dad, I’m not angry anymore. I know you are a good father.

sentences.simplified: 我一直对我的同学和朋友说，我爸爸是最好的医生，他治好了很多人的病。”
sentences.traditional: 我一直對我的同學和朋友說，我爸爸是最好的醫生，他治好了很多人的病。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yì zhí duì wǒ de tóng xué hé péng you shuō wǒ bà ba shì zuì hǎo de yī shēng tā zhì hǎo le hěn duō rén de bìng
sentences.english: I always tell my classmates and friends that my father is the best doctor, and that he has cured many people’s illnesses.”

sentences.pinyin: xiè xie nǐ duō duō xiè xie nǐ zhè me hǎo
sentences.english: “Thank you, Duoduo, thank you for being so kind.”

sentences.pinyin: wǒ ài nǐ bà ba
sentences.english: “I love you, Dad.”

sentences.simplified: “我也爱你。你能告诉我你是从什么时候开始不喜欢香蕉牛奶和蛋包饭的吗？”
sentences.traditional: “我也愛你。你能告訴我你是從什麼時候開始不喜歡香蕉牛奶和蛋包飯的嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yě ài nǐ nǐ néng gào su wǒ nǐ shì cóng shén me shí hou kāi shǐ bù xǐ huan xiāng jiāo niú nǎi hé dàn bāo fàn de ma
sentences.english: “I love you too. Can you tell me when you started to dislike banana milk and omelet rice?”

sentences.simplified: “我不记得了。应该是懂事以后，
sentences.traditional: “我不記得了。應該是懂事以後，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bú jì de le yīng gāi shì dǒng shì yǐ hòu
sentences.english: “I don’t remember anymore. It was probably after I became more mature.

sentences.simplified: 因为你不喜欢，所以慢慢地我也不喜欢了。”
sentences.traditional: 因為你不喜歡，所以慢慢地我也不喜歡了。”
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi nǐ bù xǐ huan suǒ yǐ màn man de wǒ yě bù xǐ huan le
sentences.english: Because you didn’t like them, I gradually stopped liking them as well.”

sentences.pinyin: á shì yīn wèi wǒ ma
sentences.english: “Ah? It was because of me?”

sentences.simplified: “是啊，你没有发现吗？我上中学以后，妈妈都没有买过香蕉牛奶了。”
sentences.traditional: “是啊，你沒有發現嗎？我上中學以後，媽媽都沒有買過香蕉牛奶了。”
sentences.pinyin: shì a nǐ méi yǒu fā xiàn ma wǒ shàng zhōng xué yǐ hòu mā ma dōu méi yǒu mǎi guò xiāng jiāo niú nǎi le
sentences.english: “Yes,  didn’t you notice? After I started middle school, Mom stopped buying banana milk.”

sentences.simplified: “好像是这样，对不起，我现在才知道。”
sentences.traditional: “好像是這樣，對不起，我現在才知道。”
sentences.pinyin: hǎo xiàng shì zhè yàng duì bu qǐ wǒ xiàn zài cái zhī dào
sentences.english: “That seems to be the case. I’m sorry, I only realized it now.”

sentences.simplified: “爸爸，我们不要再说对不起了。妈妈在天上看着我们呢，她希望我们过得好。”
sentences.traditional: “爸爸，我們不要再說對不起了。媽媽在天上看著我們呢，她希望我們過得好。”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba wǒ men bú yào zài shuō duì bu qǐ le mā ma zài tiān shàng kàn zhe wǒ men ne tā xī wàng wǒ men guò de hǎo
sentences.english: “Dad, let’s not say sorry anymore. Mom is watching us in heaven. She hopes we are doing well.”

sentences.simplified: “去世的人会在天上看着家人，这是很久以前的老人说过的话，你也相信吗？”
sentences.traditional: “去世的人會在天上看著家人，這是很久以前的老人說過的話，你也相信嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: qù shì de rén huì zài tiān shàng kàn zhe jiā rén zhè shì hěn jiǔ yǐ qián de lǎo rén shuō guò de huà nǐ yě xiāng xìn ma
sentences.english: “Those who have passed away will watch over their families from above. This is what old people said a long time ago. Do you believe it too?”

sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiāng xìn bà ba
sentences.english: “I believe it, Dad.”

sentences.pinyin: hǎo de duō duō nà wǒ yě xiāng xìn
sentences.english: “Okay, Duoduo, then I believe it too.”

sentences.simplified: 多多笑了，高兴地笑了。这是阿乐去世后，我第一次看到她高兴的样子。
sentences.traditional: 多多笑了，高興地笑了。這是阿樂去世後，我第一次看到她高興的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō xiào le gāo xìng de xiào le zhè shì ā yuè qù shì hòu wǒ dì yī cì kàn dào tā gāo xìng de yàng zi
sentences.english: Duoduo smiled. She smiled happily. This was the first time I had seen her happy face since Ah Yue passed away.

sentences.simplified: 这天以后，多多和我的关系变好了。
sentences.traditional: 這天以後，多多和我的關係變好了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiān yǐ hòu duō duō hé wǒ de guān xi biàn hǎo le
sentences.english: After that day, my relationship with Duoduo got better.

sentences.simplified: “适应阶段”过去了，她像以前一样和我说话，真正地说话。
sentences.traditional: “適應階段”過去了，她像以前一樣和我說話，真正地說話。
sentences.pinyin: shì yìng jiē duàn guò qù le tā xiàng yǐ qián yí yàng hé wǒ shuō huà zhēn zhèng de shuō huà
sentences.english: The “adaptation stage” was over, and she was talking to me like she used to, really talking.

sentences.simplified: 她的话变多了，她和我说工作的事，说学校的事。
sentences.traditional: 她的話變多了，她和我說工作的事，說學校的事。
sentences.pinyin: tā de huà biàn duō le tā hé wǒ shuō gōng zuò de shì shuō xué xiào de shì
sentences.english: She had more to say. She talked to me about work and school.

sentences.simplified: 以前阿乐一定也和我说过这些话，但我没有好好听。
sentences.traditional: 以前阿樂一定也和我說過這些話，但我沒有好好聽。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián ā yuè yí dìng yě hé wǒ shuō guò zhè xiē huà dàn wǒ méi yǒu hǎo hǎo tīng
sentences.english: Ah Yue must have said these words to me before, but I didn’t listen carefully.

sentences.simplified: 现在我认真地听多多的话，她说的每件事我都不想错过。
sentences.traditional: 現在我認真地聽多多的話，她說的每件事我都不想錯過。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ rèn zhēn de tīng duō duō de huà tā shuō de měi jiàn shì wǒ dōu bù xiǎng cuò guò
sentences.english: Now I listened carefully to Duoduo. I didn’t want to miss anything she said.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，多多的笑多了起来。她变得越来越好，也越来越像阿乐。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，多多的笑多了起來。她變得越來越好，也越來越像阿樂。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de duō duō de xiào duō le qǐ lái tā biàn de yuè lái yuè hǎo yě yuè lái yuè xiàng ā yuè
sentences.english: Gradually, Duoduo started to smile more. She was getting better and better, and more and more like Ah Yue.

sentences.simplified: 时间过得很快。四年后，多多三十一岁了，她成了音乐学院的学生们最喜欢的老师。
sentences.traditional: 時間過得很快。四年後，多多三十一歲了，她成了音樂學院的學生們最喜歡的老師。
sentences.pinyin: shí jiān guò de hěn kuài sì nián hòu duō duō sān shí yī suì le tā chéng le yīn yuè xué yuàn de xué sheng men zuì xǐ huan de lǎo shī
sentences.english: Time passed so quickly. Four years later, at the age of 31, Duoduo has become the students’ favorite teacher at the music academy.

sentences.simplified: 她的工作变忙了，和我聊天的时间也变少了。
sentences.traditional: 她的工作變忙了，和我聊天的時間也變少了。
sentences.pinyin: tā de gōng zuò biàn máng le hé wǒ liáo tiān de shí jiān yě biàn shǎo le
sentences.english: Her work has become busier, and she has less time to chat with me.

sentences.simplified: 这是好事，因为我知道她过得很好。而只有她过得好了，我才能离开。
sentences.traditional: 這是好事，因為我知道她過得很好。而只有她過得好了，我才能離開。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì hǎo shì yīn wèi wǒ zhī dào tā guò de hěn hǎo ér zhǐ yǒu tā guò de hǎo le wǒ cái néng lí kāi
sentences.english: This is a good thing, because I know she is doing well. And I can only leave if she is doing well.

sentences.simplified: 对，是离开，我最后还是要离开的。
sentences.traditional: 對，是離開，我最後還是要離開的。
sentences.pinyin: duì shì lí kāi wǒ zuì hòu hái shi yào lí kāi de
sentences.english: Yes, I will be leaving. Eventually, I will have to leave.

sentences.simplified: 我不能真正地陪伴她，她需要一个真正的人来陪她过每一天。
sentences.traditional: 我不能真正地陪伴她，她需要一個真正的人來陪她過每一天。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù néng zhēn zhèng de péi bàn tā tā xū yào yí ge zhēn zhèng de rén lái péi tā guò měi yì tiān
sentences.english: I can’t really be there for her. She needs a real person to keep her company each day.

sentence_translations: (8) She Hopes We Are Doing Well
“Duoduo, are you still angry?” I asked Duoduo.
“Dad, I’m not angry anymore. I know you are a good father.
I always tell my classmates and friends that my father is the best doctor, and that he has cured many people’s illnesses.”
“Thank you, Duoduo, thank you for being so kind.”
“I love you, Dad.”
“I love you too. Can you tell me when you started to dislike banana milk and omelet rice?”
“I don’t remember anymore. It was probably after I became more mature.
Because you didn’t like them, I gradually stopped liking them as well.”
“Ah? It was because of me?”
“Yes,  didn’t you notice? After I started middle school, Mom stopped buying banana milk.”
“That seems to be the case. I’m sorry, I only realized it now.”
“Dad, let’s not say sorry anymore. Mom is watching us in heaven. She hopes we are doing well.”
“Those who have passed away will watch over their families from above. This is what old people said a long time ago. Do you believe it too?”
“I believe it, Dad.”
“Okay, Duoduo, then I believe it too.”
Duoduo smiled. She smiled happily. This was the first time I had seen her happy face since Ah Yue passed away.
After that day, my relationship with Duoduo got better.
The “adaptation stage” was over, and she was talking to me like she used to, really talking.
She had more to say. She talked to me about work and school.
Ah Yue must have said these words to me before, but I didn’t listen carefully.
Now I listened carefully to Duoduo. I didn’t want to miss anything she said.
Gradually, Duoduo started to smile more. She was getting better and better, and more and more like Ah Yue.
Time passed so quickly. Four years later, at the age of 31, Duoduo has become the students’ favorite teacher at the music academy.
Her work has become busier, and she has less time to chat with me.
This is a good thing, because I know she is doing well. And I can only leave if she is doing well.
Yes, I will be leaving. Eventually, I will have to leave.
I can’t really be there for her. She needs a real person to keep her company each day.
